description:
pkix-ct/src/delivery.rs:76-78 — when OCSP response_status is not Successful (internalError, tryLater, sigRequired, unauthorized, malformedRequest), the function returns Ok(None). Same return value as a successful response with no SCT extension.

The caller passes in DER bytes from somewhere (their OCSP fetcher). Two outcomes are conflated:
1. The OCSP query succeeded but the responder did not embed SCTs in the response.
2. The OCSP query reached the responder but the responder refused / errored.

These are very different signals. A caller that wants 'do I have SCTs from OCSP for this cert?' needs to distinguish 'no, the responder gave them but the responder didn't include SCTs' from 'no, the responder is broken'.

Suggested fix: return a richer enum, e.g. Result<Option<SctList>> currently — could be Result<Option<SctList>, OcspSctError> where OcspSctError exposes the response_status code on non-Successful. Alternatively, surface non-Successful as an Err variant in pkix_ct::Error (NoOcspResult or similar). The current shape locks in the ambiguity.
title: sct_list_from_ocsp_response returns Ok(None) on non-Successful OCSP status, hiding fetch failures
